title: Android Presentation MVI
description: MVI presentation layer patterns for Android/KMP: State, Action, Event sealed types, ViewModel with StateFlow and Channel, Root/Screen composable split, UI models, UiText error mapping, and SavedStateHandle for process death. Defines a consistent structure for every screen.
trigger_description: Use whenever creating or reviewing a ViewModel, defining screen state, actions, or events, structuring composables, mapping errors to UI strings, or handling process death. Trigger phrases: "add a ViewModel", "create a screen", "MVI", "state", "action", "event", "screen composable", "UiText", "SavedStateHandle", "ObserveAsEvents", "UI model".
author: Philipp Lackner
